content:
“Spartacus, shmartacus!”— In-game description

**Wound Salter** is a Strength-based perk in *Fallout 76*, renamed and redesigned in the *CAMP Revamp* update.

Deal more damage to bleeding enemies.

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★★★ | 3 | +30% damage against bleeding targets. | 003440AA | 
| ★★ | 2 | +20% damage against bleeding targets. | 003440A9 | 
| ★ | 1 | +10% damage against bleeding targets. | 003440A8 | 

- Before update 62, the perk provided +10%/+15%/20% damage to one-handed melee weapons and was named "Gladiator."
